newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Financial extends warrant date.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Financial extends warrant date.

text.p: Advanced Financial Inc said Thursday its board is extending the expiration date of its Class B warrants to December 4, 1997.
The warrants were originally scheduled to expire December 4, 1996, said the company.

Currently, there are 400,000 warrants outstanding at the exercise price of $10 for one share of Advanced Financial, it said. The warrants were included in the units sold in the company's public offer in a prospectus dated June 4, 1991. To date, no warrants have been exercised, said the company.
Advanced Financial is a mortgage bank holding comapny.
